top_signals.title: Multiple Fed Rate Hikes Reasonable, Pimco's Wilding Says
top_signals.summary: Pimco Economist Tiffany Wilding says the US employment report does not change her outlook for a Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Wilding says another Fed rate increase in March is possible, describing the moves as a recalibration of policy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Walmart to take drone delivery nationwide as Zipline raises $1.5B
top_signals.summary:
Walmart will significantly scale up its drone delivery network in partnership with Zipline, which will operate the small unmanned aerial vehicles from 300 new store locations and has raised $1.5 billion in new funding to build out a nationwide drone delivery capacity, the companies announced on Thursday.
